purpose: Visual design prototypes only; no application implementation.
commonPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished straight-on desktop screen for Meridian Grid, approximately 1600x1050 landscape, flat screenshot with no device or browser chrome. The attached dashboard is the STYLE REFERENCE, not the screen to reproduce. Match its restrained professional visual language exactly: very pale gray #F5F7F9 main canvas, white surfaces, ink #172635, slate secondary text #73808C, deep navy #122232, teal #137D76 primary actions, ochre #D6A34B solar accents. Clean sans typography, generous whitespace, precise alignment, restrained 8px radii, thin subtle separators, almost no shadow. No gradients, neon, glass, clutter, oversized icon grids or gratuitous cards. All text legible and purposeful. This is a design concept for the current backend; never invent live telemetry, approvals, guaranteed savings, capabilities or security claims. Preserve the small amber grid MERIDIAN / GRID wordmark. Return only the image.
